newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL to publish H1 results on Aug 30.
newsitem.headline: MOL to publish H1 results on Aug 30.

text.p: Hungary's oil and gas company Magyar Olaj- es Gazipari Rt said that it will publish its 1996 first half results on August 30, after the Budapest bourse rejected MOL's request to extend the deadline.
"The BSE, while it found the reasons of the application well-grounded and reasonable, based on its own regulations, could not grant a formal extension," MOL said in statement.

MOL applied for an extension of the usual August 15 submission deadline to the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) saying it was preparing audited first half results ahead of the second phase of its privatisation later this year.

The state privatisation agency APV Rt still holds 58.6 percent of MOL, which has a registered capital of 98.4 billion forints, and is expected to announce shortly the second phase of the privatisation.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange MOL closed at 1,540 forints, down 10, on Wednesday.
